fields.Name: T363 - Component Browser Filter Panel
fields.Description: Exercises the component browser's bespoke collapsible filter panel (favorites/deprecated/category pills + active-filter badge) — unique to Component Studio, unlike the generic grid's advanced-filter builder.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Component Studio app (Components section), click the filter toggle button (a sliders icon) in the browser header controls row to expand the collapsible filter panel. Verify the panel renders its filter controls: a 'Favorites only' checkbox, a 'Show deprecated' checkbox, and — if categories exist — a set of category pill buttons. Toggle 'Favorites only' or a category pill and verify the component list/count responds (or a no-results empty state appears). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the filter panel render and react is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking the filter toggle expands a filter panel showing 'Favorites only' and 'Show deprecated' options
Toggling a filter (favorites or a category pill) updates the component list or the 'X of Y' count, or shows a no-results state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
